facts.fact: RSF says that in early 2024 restrictions such as internet shutdowns undermined the right to inform in Senegal; who ordered them and how long they lasted are not stated.

note: Index rank and score are other. Arrests of two journalists and two TV channels taken off air (29 Oct 2025), and Walfadjri suspension (early 2024): document does not say what was said or published, so no penalty fact. Registration procedure criticism is by unnamed industry members.
